grains.RAW.PLANTS: one row per renewable power plant
grains.RAW.PLANT_DAILY: one row per plant per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.DEFECT_SURVEY: one row per plant (inspection survey defect snapshot)

metrics.Meter Data Valid: 100 * SUM(INTERVALS_VALID) / SUM(METER_INTERVALS) (15-minute intervals passing the internal data-quality check)
metrics.Estimated Avoided Emissions: SUM(AVOIDED_TCO2E) / 1000 (kt CO2e; generation x internal demo emission factor, an estimate and not a carbon credit)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.outage_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(forced generation outage in next 7 days) per plant, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio-wide estimated avoided CO2e FORECAST; power-conversion equipment temperature ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.OUTAGE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic outage-response SOPs (one per plant type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.RENEWABLE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.RENEWABLE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, outage, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (plants with observations, daily meter data valid, outages by plant, outage risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
